verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents its own recurring automation: payroll can be set to run automatically after setup ([docs-2]), and auto payroll runs for salaried direct-deposit employees with review and approval ([docs-9]). It also offers automated multi-step HR workflows with approval chains ([docs-15]), but nothing shows those workflows can be scheduled. The recurring capability is limited to a fixed payroll job, not general user-defined scheduling. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary jobs or workflows, schedule configuration details (cadence, triggers), scheduling of HR workflows, API or programmatic schedule control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
